players_confusion_1.speaker: player
text: I used to be a big fan of fights in the colosseum
I once bought a fully working gladiator armor set from my friends because it looked cool
One day, I was talking to my wife Livia. We just had our first child Maximus.
Two guys in a black armor forced me to go with them. Livia tried to stop them but they didn't
When I woke up, I was here.. In a dark room with nothing in sight.

lanista_1.speaker: lanista
text: Ah, you woke up my friend
